Exercise: Pushups (Close and Wide Hand Positions)

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- vertical_push

Primary Muscles:

- chest

Secondary Muscles:

- shoulders
- triceps

Equipment:

- bodyweight

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- strength_building
- cardiovascular_endurance

Contraindications:

- condition: recent shoulder injury, reason: High risk of exacerbating the condition.
- condition: shoulder instability, reason: May cause further instability or pain.

Exercise Variations:

- name: Pushups (Close and Wide Hand Positions) with Knee Bends, force: push, level: intermediate
- name: Pushups (Close and Wide Hand Positions) on an Incline, force: push, level: intermediate

Substitution Options:

- name: Incline Pushups, force: push, level: beginner
- name: Wall Pushups, force: push, level: beginner

Instructions:

- Lie on the floor face down and body straight with your toes on the floor and the hands wider than shoulder width for a wide hand position and closer than shoulder width for a close hand position. Make sure you are holding your torso up at arms length.
- Lower yourself until your chest almost touches the floor as you inhale.
- Using your pectoral muscles, press your upper body back up to the starting position and squeeze your chest. Breathe out as you perform this step.
- After a second pause at the contracted position, repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
